items.rationale: Theft damage on the recovered bike is covered under 2.3.1(b)/7.1.1(b). The mobility class sub-limit of EUR 500 (4.2.2) is shared rateably with the repair and recovery lines (about 1,010 gross claimed), so roughly 0.49 x 349.
Theft damage is covered. The EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit applies rateably at about 0.49 x 148.
A tracking device that was not itself damaged is excluded under 4.2.3, 3.1.7 and 7.1.8(b).
This is servicing of an unaffected item, excluded under 3.1.6, 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a)/(b).
Supplementary or protective equipment that was not affected by the theft is excluded under 4.2.3 and 3.1.7.
Carriage of parts for the covered repair is included under 7.1.7(f). It is scaled by the sub-limit factor of about 0.49.
An attendance on a repair invoice could be covered under 7.1.7(g), but case 24 showed a very low or zero threshold for this line. Any amount would also be scaled by the sub-limit.
Fitting the replacement parts is part of the repair under 7.1.7(c). It is scaled by the aggregate sub-limit at about 0.49 x 150.
An unspecified sundry line was never indemnified in earlier cases. The invoice also mixes excluded work, so this line cannot be allocated to the covered repair.
In case 24 this line was not or barely indemnified. If allowed, it would be scaled by the sub-limit.
Repair labour is covered under 7.1.7(d) at about 40, scaled by the sub-limit factor of about 0.49.
An attendance at the place of recovery is covered under 5.2.2(a), but it falls under the mobility sub-limit and is scaled rateably. Case 26 showed a low threshold for this line.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Cutting the lock is a recovery cost under 5.2.2(b), about 108 unscaled. It is subject to the EUR 500 class sub-limit and scaled at about 0.49.
This second call-out was not required by the recovery, so 7.1.8(f) applies; it was never indemnified in earlier cases.
A third-party release charge is covered under 5.2.2(c): 100 + VAT = 119. It is scaled by the mobility sub-limit at about 0.49.
Administration and claim-processing charges are excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(d).
Labour on the lock removal is covered under 5.2.2(b), but apprentice hours were rarely accepted before. If allowed, they would be scaled by the sub-limit.
Recovery labour is covered under 5.2.2(b) at about 40, scaled by the sub-limit at about 0.49.
